kids.personality: Confident, often wrong, hand always up.
Shy. Never volunteers. Speaks only when asked by name, quietly and briefly.
Fast learner. Gets bored without a challenge.

topics.vocab: كسر، كسور، بسط، مقام، نص، ثلث، ربع، منسف، fraction, numerator, denominator, half, third, quarter

omar.misconception: Thinks a bigger bottom number means a bigger fraction: 3 is bigger than 2, so 1/3 is bigger than 1/2.
omar.helped_if: Explains that cutting one whole into MORE equal parts makes EACH part SMALLER (e.g. one mansaf shared by 3 people instead of 2).
omar.hurt_if: Says or implies that the bigger number makes the bigger fraction.

reveal.en: Thought a bigger bottom number means a bigger fraction. Needed to see that more equal parts means each part is smaller.
reveal.ar: كان مفكّر إنه كل ما كبر الرقم تحت بيكبر الكسر. كان بدّه يشوف إنه كل ما زادت القطع، صغرت كل قطعة.

next_check.en: Which is bigger, 1/5 or 1/4? How do you know?

lina.misconception: Sees a fraction as two separate whole numbers (1 and 3), not as one amount.
lina.helped_if: Shows a fraction as ONE amount: a part of one whole (food, a drawing, a shape) or one point on a number line.
lina.hurt_if: Treats the top and bottom numbers as two separate numbers to compare.

reveal.en: Saw a fraction as two separate numbers. A drawing of one whole cut into parts, or a number line, would have helped.
reveal.ar: كانت شايفة الكسر رقمين منفصلين. رسمة لشي كامل مقسوم لقطع، أو خط الأعداد، كان رح يساعدها.

next_check.en: Show me where 1/3 goes on a line from 0 to 1.
next_check.ar: وين بتحطي 1/3 على خط من 0 لـ 1؟

sara.misconception: Memorised 'bigger bottom number = smaller fraction' with no idea why.
sara.helped_if: Gives the REASON (more equal parts means each part is smaller), not only the rule.
sara.hurt_if: Says 'just memorise the rule' or only repeats the rule.

reveal.en: Had memorised the rule with no reason. Needed to hear why it works.
reveal.ar: كانت حافظة القاعدة بدون ما تعرف ليش. كانت بدها تسمع السبب.

next_check.en: Why is 1/8 smaller than 1/4? Tell me the reason, not the rule.
next_check.ar: ليش 1/8 أصغر من 1/4؟ احكيلي السبب، مش القاعدة.

khaled.misconception: Can't see why fractions matter in real life.
khaled.helped_if: Uses a concrete real-life example (mansaf, pizza, ka'ak, a chocolate bar, money).
khaled.hurt_if: Says it only matters for the exam.

reveal.en: Couldn't see where he'd use it. A real-life example (mansaf, pizza, ka'ak) would have reached him.
reveal.ar: ما كان شايف وين رح يستخدمها. مثال من الحياة (منسف، بيتزا، كعك) كان رح يوصله.

next_check.en: You want the biggest slice of pizza: 1/6 or 1/3?

yazan.misconception: Already understands. Gets bored when the basics are repeated.
yazan.helped_if: Gives him a harder challenge (e.g. which is bigger, 3/4 or 4/5?) or asks him to explain to the class.
yazan.hurt_if: Repeats the same basic point again with nothing new.

reveal.en: Already understood. A harder challenge (3/4 or 4/5?) would have kept him with you.
reveal.ar: كان فاهم من الأول. سؤال أصعب (3/4 ولا 4/5؟) كان رح يخلّيه معك.

next_check.en: Which is bigger, 3/4 or 4/5? Explain how you know.
next_check.ar: أيهما أكبر: 3/4 ولا 4/5؟ فسّر كيف عرفت.

topics.vocab: سالب، موجب، صفر، خط الأعداد، حرارة، دين، negative, positive, zero, number line, temperature, debt

omar.misconception: Thinks -5 is bigger than -2 because 5 is bigger than 2.
omar.helped_if: Uses a number line, temperature or floors to show that numbers further below zero are smaller.
omar.hurt_if: Compares negative numbers by their digits only.

reveal.en: Compared -5 and -2 by the digits. A number line or temperatures would have helped.
reveal.ar: كان بقارن −5 و −2 بالأرقام بس. خط الأعداد أو درجات الحرارة كانت رح تساعده.

lina.misconception: Thinks negative numbers aren't real numbers.
lina.helped_if: Gives negative numbers a real meaning (debt, temperature below zero, floors below ground).
lina.hurt_if: Presents negative numbers as rules with no meaning.

reveal.en: Didn't believe negative numbers are real. Debt or a temperature below zero would have made them real.
reveal.ar: ما كانت مصدقة إنه الأعداد السالبة حقيقية. الدَّين أو الحرارة تحت الصفر كانت رح تقنعها.

next_check.en: Tell me one place in real life where you see a negative number.
next_check.ar: احكيلي مكان بالحياة بتشوفي فيه عدد سالب.

sara.helped_if: Explains WHY subtracting a negative makes the result bigger (e.g. removing a debt), not only 'two minuses make a plus'.
sara.hurt_if: Says 'two minuses make a plus, just memorise it'.

reveal.en: Thought taking away a negative still makes it smaller. Removing a debt shows why it goes up.
reveal.ar: كانت مفكرة إنه الطرح دايماً بنقّص. شطب دَين بوضّح ليش النتيجة بتزيد.

next_check.en: You owe 2 dinars and someone cancels the debt. Are you richer or poorer?
next_check.ar: عليكي دينارين، وحدا شطب الدَّين. صرتي أغنى ولا أفقر؟

khaled.misconception: Can't see where negative numbers appear in real life.
khaled.helped_if: Uses temperature, money and debt, or lift floors.
khaled.hurt_if: Says it only matters for the exam.

reveal.en: Needed a real example: temperature, money or lift floors.
reveal.ar: كان بدّه مثال من الحياة: الحرارة، المصاري، أو طوابق المصعد.

next_check.en: The lift is at floor -1 and goes up 3 floors. Where is it now?
next_check.ar: المصعد على طابق −1 وطلع 3 طوابق. وين صار؟

yazan.misconception: Already understands. Gets bored when the basics are repeated.
yazan.helped_if: Gives a harder challenge (e.g. -3 - (-7)) or asks him to explain to the class.
yazan.hurt_if: Repeats the basics with nothing new.

reveal.en: Already understood. A harder problem like -3 - (-7) would have kept him with you.
reveal.ar: كان فاهم من الأول. مسألة أصعب مثل −3 − (−7) كانت رح تخلّيه معك.

next_check.en: What is -3 - (-7)? Show it on a number line.

topics.vocab: بناء ضوئي، تنفس، ثاني أكسيد الكربون، أكسجين، جلوكوز، ضوء، photosynthesis, respiration, carbon dioxide, oxygen, glucose, light

omar.misconception: Thinks plants get their food from the soil.
omar.helped_if: Explains that plants MAKE their own food (glucose) from carbon dioxide and water, using light.
omar.hurt_if: Says plants eat or get their food from the soil.

reveal.en: Thought plants eat from the soil. Needed to hear that they make their own food from air, water and light.
reveal.ar: كان مفكر إنه النبتة بتوكل من التراب. كان لازم يسمع إنها بتصنع أكلها من الهوا والمي والضو.

next_check.en: A tree weighs 500 kg. Where did most of that mass come from?
next_check.ar: شجرة وزنها 500 كيلو. من وين إجا معظم وزنها؟

lina.helped_if: Says plants respire all the time, day and night, like animals.
lina.hurt_if: Says plants only breathe at night, or don't breathe.

reveal.en: Thought plants don't breathe. Needed to hear that they respire day and night.
reveal.ar: كانت مفكرة إنه النباتات ما بتتنفس. كان لازم تسمع إنها بتتنفس ليل ونهار.

next_check.en: Does a plant breathe at night? And in the day?

sara.misconception: Mixes up photosynthesis and breathing: 'plants breathe in CO2 instead of oxygen'.
sara.helped_if: Clearly separates photosynthesis (takes in CO2, gives out O2, needs light) from respiration (takes in O2, all the time).
sara.hurt_if: Says plants 'breathe CO2' or mixes the two processes up.

reveal.en: Mixed up photosynthesis and breathing. Needed the two processes side by side.
reveal.ar: كانت خالطة بين البناء الضوئي والتنفس. كانت بدها تشوفهم جنب بعض.

next_check.en: What does a leaf take in for photosynthesis, and what for respiration?
next_check.ar: شو بتاخد الورقة بالبناء الضوئي؟ وشو بتاخد بالتنفس؟

khaled.helped_if: Uses a concrete example (e.g. most of a tree's mass comes from the air; all the food we eat starts with photosynthesis).

reveal.en: Needed something real: most of a tree's mass comes from the air.
reveal.ar: كان بدّه إشي حقيقي: معظم وزن الشجرة جاي من الهوا.

next_check.en: Name one food you ate today that started with photosynthesis.
next_check.ar: احكيلي أكلة أكلتها اليوم بلّشت من البناء الضوئي.

yazan.misconception: Already understands. Gets bored when the basics are repeated.
yazan.helped_if: Gives a harder question (e.g. why does a plant in a dark room die even with water and soil?) or asks him to explain to the class.
yazan.hurt_if: Repeats the basics with nothing new.

reveal.en: Already understood. A harder question (why does a plant die in the dark?) would have kept him with you.
reveal.ar: كان فاهم من الأول. سؤال أصعب (ليش النبتة بتموت بالعتمة؟) كان رح يخلّيه معك.

next_check.en: Why does a plant in a dark room die even with water and soil?
next_check.ar: ليش النبتة بتموت بغرفة معتمة حتى لو في مي وتراب؟
